hero.title: Corporate transaction simulator: capital increases, share sales and convertible notes
hero.description: Sttok simulates a capital increase, a reduction, a share sale or a note conversion on the actual data in the shareholder register. It chains several transactions, calculates the liquidation waterfall and prepares draft documents.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the simulator

items.a: Capital increases and reductions, share sales and convertible note conversions, also chained together, and the liquidation waterfall of a sale.
The company's actual shareholder register, with its numbering, its classes and its capital as of the date.

items.q: Does a simulation change the register?
items.a: No. A simulation records nothing. The transaction enters the register when it is recorded with its deed.

items.q: Can I describe the transaction in words?
items.a: Yes. The simulator's assistant builds the transaction from a description: valuation, who contributes, who sells and how much.
The company's directors. Each simulation is saved and can be shared with them.

items.q: Does it work for companies in Latin America?
items.a: The platform adapts to each country's terminology: shareholder ledger, general shareholders' meeting, board of directors. Compliance with each country's regulations is assessed case by case.

includes.title: What you can simulate in Sttok

rows.situation: A new shareholder comes in through a capital increase
rows.action: Price per share, new shares and each shareholder's dilution are calculated before the meeting is called.

rows.situation: One family branch wants to buy from another
rows.action: The sale is simulated and each shareholder's position afterwards is shown.
The resulting shares and their effect on the other shareholders are calculated.

rows.situation: The sale of the company is being negotiated
rows.action: The liquidation waterfall shows what each shareholder receives, with the preferences of each class.

rows.situation: The transaction has to go to the notary
rows.action: Draft documents in Word are prepared with the simulation data.
